name: Nightmare
description: (Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:time)(Tag:vampiric)Race - You are a Nightmare vampire born from Dead Apostle blood with superhuman physical and magical abilities. You regenerate by rewinding while you hold blood and can turn people into ghouls. You wield your own unique Elite Rank Ability with no ability slot and evolve to the next undeath stage by consuming enough blood.
